name: Hermite Dual Marching Cubes
aliases: Dual Marching Cubes with Hermite data
Nielson's Dual Marching Cubes with QEF
definition: A contouring method that combines the topology guarantees of Dual Marching Cubes (which produces a manifold surface) with the feature-preserving capability of Dual Contouring (which uses Hermite data to place vertices accurately). It solves the problem of non-manifold vertices/edges in standard Dual Contouring on uniform grids while preserving sharp features.
summary: Hermite Dual Marching Cubes is a surface extraction method that produces manifold meshes with sharp features by minimizing a Quadratic Error Function derived from Hermite data.
